visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three men with dark, shoulder-length wigs are walking on a wooden rooftop toward the camera. One is wearing a black suit and sunglasses, another a white sleeveless dress over jeans, and the third a white suit. The background shows an urban skyline with various buildings under clear daylight. (2) The characters stop in the center of the frame and strike exaggerated fashion poses. The person in the white dress brushes their hair back, while the others gesture toward the camera with smiling, theatrical expressions. (3) A series of close-up cuts show individual members attempting to move in front of each other to capture the center position. The person in the white dress dramatically flips their long black hair upward in slow motion. (4) The scene transitions to an indoor setting with a plain light-colored wall. The three men are holding instruments: a green melodica, a silver microphone, and an acoustic guitar. They are swaying and 'performing' with exaggerated mouth movements. (5) Fast-paced editing shows close-up shots of the person in the black suit blowing into the melodica tube while looking into the lens. The background is a simple indoor wall with a power outlet visible. (6) A still shot of four skincare product bottles and their packaging is displayed on a wooden surface in front of a grey sofa. The products are white and orange containers with 'Derma Lab' branding. (7) Close-ups of hands applying clear and beige liquids from the bottles. The characters are then shown rubbing the serums onto their faces with intense, comical expressions of satisfaction. (8) The group is back to performing together indoors, holding the products while singing. The person in the white dress holds a microphone and waves their arms as the others pose behind them.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins at a fast rate with an upbeat, rhythmic BGM featuring a strong 4/4 drum beat and bright synth chords. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX triggers as visual frames shift, followed by a comedic 'engine revving' sound effect coinciding with the 'overtaking' dialogue. (3) A loud hair-flip sound effect and several high-pitched 'dings' mark the camera flashes and poses. (4) The BGM transitions into a melodic pop track with exaggerated male singing. The vocals show high arousal and comedic tension with long, vibrato-heavy notes. (5) Rapid-fire SFX of camera shutters and a comical 'slap' sound follow. A continuous, slightly discordant melodica note drones in the background. (6) The vocal tone shifts to a rhythmic, commercial delivery as product benefits are chanted, while the acoustic guitar provides a steady rhythmic accompaniment. (7) Final climactic vocal segment with high-pitched shouting and long vocal tails, ending with a hard cut into silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Conflict (Center Position Battle) -> Resolution (United by Product) -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Derma Lab skincare products using a comedic parody of a 'trendy boy band' (S.D.M) struggling for individual attention, ultimately suggesting the products help everyone shine in the 'center' position.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of products, close-ups of application, and slogans regarding sales at Watsons.
